source_caption:
🎬 Jerry & Marge Go Large (2022)

Jerry & Marge Go Large tells the remarkable true story of Jerry Selbee, a retired factory worker with an extraordinary talent for mathematics who discovers a legal loophole in a state lottery game. Realizing that certain lottery drawings offer unusually favorable odds, Jerry develops a strategy that allows him to win substantial amounts of money. With the support of his wife, Marge, he begins purchasing thousands of lottery tickets, turning an unusual retirement hobby into an unexpected financial adventure. Rather than keeping their winnings entirely for themselves, the couple decides to use their success to help revitalize their struggling hometown in Michigan. However, their remarkable strategy eventually attracts attention from other players and investigators. Starring Bryan Cranston and Annette Bening, the film combines heartwarming comedy, clever storytelling, and an inspiring message about love, teamwork, generosity, and finding new opportunities later in life.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Comedy • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 6.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 36m • PG-13

🎥 Director: David Frankel

✍️ Writer: Brad Copeland

📺 Where to Watch: Paramount+ in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Jerry & Marge Go Large is a 2022 American comedy-drama film directed by David Frankel and written by Brad Copeland. Based on Jason Fagone's 2018 HuffPost article of the same name, the film, which is based on the true story of Jerry and Marge Selbee, stars Bryan Cranston and Annette Bening. The film premiered at the Tribeca Film Festival on June 15, 2022, and was released on Paramount+ on June 17, 2022.
